title: Others on the New York trip: trumpeter Bell
summary: He recalls only trumpeter Bell from New Orleans, Roy Palmer, Big Bill and Washington on the trip.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Do you remember anybody else on that trip that went over with you in the car that drove over from Chicago? By name,
I don't, there was a trumpet player named Bell. He was a New Orleans boy, too.

Yeah. His last name was Bell. Bell? Bell, and he played a very nice trumpet. And he had the New Orleans jazz, but he was as strong like Louie and the King like that. And he was originated from New Orleans. and I don't know what happened to him or to come of him since those days. Now, anybody else outside Rona Parma and Big Bill and this Al Washington, he's up in his 60s, you know, Al, since he was a young man than I was. And I said, I know him from a kid. That's about all I can remember during that
dad recording. That's a big deal because most people don't remember who, Roy didn't remember who those fellows were except you. He mentioned you.
He remembered me, you see, and I remember Bill, Roy, and Big Bill. And I can't remember, there was quite a few of them that bunch, but I just can't remember the names.
